vacancy.title: EO Future Mission End-to-end System Engineer (2 posts)
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESA ESTEC A2-A4 role in early-phase Earth observation mission architecture, system requirements, study management and end-to-end performance simulation. Strong MSc generalist engineering and technical coordination fit, but six years of relevant space-mission preparation/development plus EO remote-sensing and performance-simulation expertise are major stretch requirements. Four-year appointment extendable to indefinite.
